using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

vector<int> factorial;

int modPow(int base, long long exp, int mod) {
    int result = 1;
    base %= mod;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
            result = (int)((1LL * result * base) % mod);
        }
        base = (int)((1LL * base * base) % mod);
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

long long nCr(int n, int r) {
    long long numerator = factorial[n];
    long long denominator = (1LL * factorial[n - r] * factorial[r]) % MOD;
    long long invDenom = modPow((int)denominator, MOD - 2, MOD);
    return (numerator * invDenom) % MOD;
}

long long gcd(long long a, long long b) {
    return b == 0 ? a : gcd(b, a % b);
}

long long lcm(long long a, long long b) {
    return a / gcd(a, b) * b;
}

int logBase(int n, int base) {
    int result = 0;
    while (n + 1 > base) {
        result++;
        n /= base;
    }
    return result;
}

long long square(long long x) {
    return x * x;
}

class Pair {
public:
    int x, y;

    Pair(int a, int b) {
        x = a;
        y = b;
    }

    bool operator<(const Pair& other) const {
        if (x != other.x) {
            return x < other.x;
        }
        return y < other.y;
    }

    bool operator==(const Pair& other) const {
        return x == other.x && y == other.y;
    }

    bool operator!=(const Pair& other) const {
        return !(*this == other);
    }
};

namespace std {
    template<>
    struct hash<Pair> {
        size_t operator()(const Pair& p) const {
            return hash<int>()(p.x) ^ (hash<int>()(p.y) << 1);
        }
    };
}

class Scanner {
private:
    string line;
    int pos;
    bool finished;

public:
    Scanner() : pos(0), finished(false) {}

    long long nextLong() {
        skipWhitespace();
        long long result = 0;
        bool negative = false;
        if (pos < line.size() && line[pos] == '-') {
            negative = true;
            pos++;
        }
        while (pos < line.size() && isdigit(line[pos])) {
            result = result * 10 + (line[pos] - '0');
            pos++;
        }
        if (negative) result = -result;
        return result;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return (int)nextLong();
    }

    string next() {
        skipWhitespace();
        string result = "";
        while (pos < line.size() && !isspace(line[pos])) {
            result += line[pos];
            pos++;
        }
        return result;
    }

    double nextDouble() {
        skipWhitespace();
        string token = "";
        while (pos < line.size() && !isspace(line[pos])) {
            token += line[pos];
            pos++;
        }
        
        double result = 0;
        bool negative = false;
        bool decimal = false;
        double divisor = 1;
        
        int start = 0;
        if (token[0] == '-') {
            negative = true;
            start = 1;
        }
        
        for (int i = start; i < token.length(); i++) {
            char c = token[i];
            if (c == '.') {
                decimal = true;
            } else {
                result = result * 10 + (c - '0');
                if (decimal) {
                    divisor *= 10;
                }
            }
        }
        
        result /= divisor;
        return negative ? -result : result;
    }

    void nextLine() {
        if (getline(cin, line)) {
            pos = 0;
        } else {
            finished = true;
        }
    }

    bool ready() {
        if (pos >= line.size() && !finished) {
            nextLine();
        }
        return !finished;
    }

private:
    void skipWhitespace() {
        while (pos < line.size() && isspace(line[pos])) {
            pos++;
        }
    }
};

void shuffle(vector<int>& arr) {
    random_device rd;
    mt19937 g(rd());
    for (int i = arr.size() - 1; i > 0; i--) {
        uniform_int_distribution<int> dist(0, i);
        int j = dist(g);
        swap(arr[i], arr[j]);
    }
}

int main() {
    Scanner sc;
    
    int n = sc.nextInt();
    long long k = sc.nextLong();
    
    if (k > n - 1) {
        cout << 0 << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    
    factorial.resize(n + 1);
    factorial[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        factorial[i] = (int)((1LL * factorial[i - 1] * i) % MOD);
    }
    
    int pop = n - (int)k;
    long long ans = 0;
    
    for (int i = 0; i <= pop; i++) {
        long long term = (nCr(pop, i) * modPow(pop - i, n, MOD)) % MOD;
        if (i % 2 == 1) {
            term = (term * -1 + MOD) % MOD;
        }
        ans = (ans + term) % MOD;
    }
    
    ans = (ans * nCr(n, pop)) % MOD;
    if (k != 0) {
        ans = (ans * 2) % MOD;
    }
    
    cout << ans << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
